canvasIntro.title: Make Your Board
canvasIntro.subtitle: Pedalboard Planner
canvasIntro.desktopText:
Select pedals, pedalboards and power supplies from the left panel.
Drag, drop and arrange them to create your perfect setup.
Check your power supply and share your pedalboard with friends.
canvasIntro.mobileText:

Check your power supply and share your pedalboard with friends.

help.title: Quick guide
help.gearText: Add pedals, a board and a power supply to create your ideal pedalboard.
help.jacksText: Make sure the pedals are spaced far enough apart to allow room for cables.
help.powerText: Check that your power supply is compatible with your pedals and has enough capacity.
help.shareText: Export your pedalboard as a PNG to save or share it.
help.welcomeText: MakeYourBoard is a free tool for designing your ideal pedalboard. Add your board, pedals and power supply, arrange your setup the way you like and see the result in just a few clicks. Built for pedal enthusiasts, I hope you find it useful and fun to use.
help.contactTitle: Have feedback, an idea or just want to get in touch?
help.contactText: MakeYourBoard is a solo project I develop in my spare time, so your feedback, ideas and suggestions are always welcome. If you enjoy the tool and want to contribute to its development, you can also support the project. Thank you 🤘
